headline.purpose: Leading heading below the desktop breakpoint; balanced lines and long-text wrapping.

headline-desktop.purpose: Leading heading at viewport widths of at least 60rem.

title.purpose: The collection heading, visually below the headline.

body.purpose: Supporting introduction text in the same locally loaded Manrope family.

label.purpose: Visible, resizable project names centered below decorative icons.

motion.name: project-icon-transition
motion.purpose: Transition the decorative icon only during real interaction; never animate arrival or idle states.

motion.name: project-icon-hover
motion.purpose: Small playful feedback only for hover-capable fine pointers.

motion.name: project-icon-active
motion.purpose: Press feedback that takes precedence over the hover transform.

motion.name: project-icon-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove both transition and interaction transforms under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; retain surface and focus feedback.

narrative.overview:
Warm, personal, and understated: the identity feels like a small collection of useful things, not a performance by its maker. The supplied monochrome monogram and Manrope carry recognition; restrained cobalt adds a small, clear point of emphasis. Approachable typography and careful spacing matter more than ornamental treatment or borrowed branding.

The implemented visual language is compact without feeling crowded. White space, quiet tonal surfaces, and consistently rounded icon boxes make room for individual project character. A true-black system dark appearance belongs to the same identity. Playfulness is confined to small movements during real interaction, with equally clear nonmoving feedback.
keyCharacteristics: Supplied monochrome monogram at a deliberately modest optical size.
Manrope throughout, with weight and spacing creating hierarchy.
Restrained cobalt on white or a true-black system dark canvas.
Compact, consistent icon surfaces with distinct project tones.
Quiet, accessible feedback only during interaction.

rules.name: The System Appearance Rule
rules.body: Follow the system color preference automatically, preserve the true-black dark canvas, and do not add a theme toggle.

rules.name: The Contained Color Rule
rules.body: Keep cobalt as the identity accent; give project icons distinct tones without changing their shared geometry or coloring their name labels.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Preserve Manrope across the wordmark, headings, copy, and labels; use the established weight and size relationships instead of introducing another typeface.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Use tonal separation and the established hairline rather than inventing shadows or glass effects for these components.

dos: **Do** use the supplied monochrome monogram at its modest optical size beside the Manrope wordmark.
**Do** preserve cobalt as the identity accent and the system-driven white/true-black canvas.
**Do** keep project-specific tones inside the consistent rounded icon geometry.
**Do** retain the approved responsive icon/name grid, native same-tab links, and visible focus.
**Do** balance empty-state copy and allow the wordmark and project names to reflow with enlarged text.
**Do** keep decorative initials fixed inside their icon box while visible names remain resizable.
**Do** honor reduced motion by removing icon movement while retaining clear state feedback.
donts: **Don't** redraw the supplied mark, enlarge it into a hero motif, or replace the approved Manrope identity.
**Don't** substitute a gray dark canvas or add a theme toggle.
**Don't** add arrival animation, idle animation, or movement to the static empty illustration.
**Don't** fill the zero-project state with fictional entries, loading skeletons, or unavailable actions.
**Don't** restore the earlier lower-contrast teal treatment or clip enlarged text to preserve a rigid layout.
**Don't** promote local illustration values, synthetic swatch ramps, or off-surface control styles into global tokens.
